messages:
Alice Chen: Quick sync — thinking through private-offer layering for our new HW partner + SI bundle. Two asks: (1) how to stack committed spend discounts vs HW rebates, (2) renewal cadence that doesn't kill downstream renewals. Any initial takes?

Mateo Rivera: I’d keep it simple: 3 commit tiers (100k / 500k / 1m). Each tier = baseline % discount on hosted API + credit multiplier for SI services. Hardware rebate sits outside the marketplace private offer (so partner invoices separately).

Mateo Rivera: Example: Tier Silver (500k) => 12% API discount + 15% SI credit up to 200k. If partner provides HW rebate, we treat as separate line item to avoid double-counting.

Priya Singh: A couple legal constraints: marketplace private offers need clear term length and renewal trigger. Avoid making discounts contingent on undefined "adoption metrics" — define explicit usage buckets. Also include audit/reporting cadence (monthly basic, quarterly deep-dive).

Priya Singh: Also: include fallback pricing if customer goes below committed usage for 2 consecutive months. We usually do a taper (30/60/90 days) before reclaiming credits.

Jordan Park: Heads up: different marketplaces have different private-offer metadata. GCP Marketplace only supports X-day private offer windows and a single effective discount line for VM SKUs — can't layer multiple marketplace discounts. So we should model multi-part discounts as: (a) marketplace visible discount (API hosted fees), (b) off-marketplace rebate (HW or SI) delivered via partner invoice/credit.

Jordan Park: Also factor in marketplace fee (~5-12%) when calculating net to us.

Claire Thomas: From GTM perspective: if there's a joint announcement, legal needs 4 weeks review and partner comms need 2 weeks. Recommend we align on a public launch window only after the private offer is live for at least 10 business days and we have first customer usage > baseline. Partners want case studies — we should bake that into renewal incentives (extra 2% discount at renewal if customer agrees to a case study). :sparkles:

Alice Chen: Good call on splitting marketplace visible vs off-marketplace. Proposal: publish private offer with explicit API discount lines by tier, and a separate partner rebate schedule (SOW/invoice). Renewal cadence: 12-month term with optional 12-month extension at a pre-negotiated floor price and a usage-based true-up every quarter.

Alice Chen: Action items: Mateo — draft tier table + sample SKUs by EOD Wed; Priya — draft contract language for taper + audit; Jordan — verify marketplace SKU constraints for Azure, AWS, GCP and flag any blockers; Claire — propose joint-announce timeline options. I'll consolidate and share a single doc.

Mateo Rivera: ACK. Will include an example CSV mapping for private offer SKUs and partner credit lines.

Priya Singh: ACK. I'll include suggested language for case-study-linked renewal bonus.

Jordan Park: ACK. Will escalate any marketplace mismatches ASAP.

contract-bot: Reminder: ACME Corp. private-offer renewal window opens in 18 days (2026-04-08).

Claire Thomas: One more note — recommend we cap partner stackable discounts at 20% total net to avoid margin erosion. Happy to model the numbers if you want.

Alice Chen: Yes please model scenarios v1 (conservative), v2 (aggressive). Mateo + Claire — can you pair on that? Planning sync tomorrow 10:30am PT.
